articles.title: Park Lawn Road westbound Gardiner on-ramp reopens two months early
articles.summary: The Park Lawn Road westbound on-ramp to the Gardiner Expressway reopened at 6 a.m. on Friday after critical bridge replacement work was completed two months early, according to a City of Toronto news release. articles.title: Man dead after stabbing on TTC bus in Scarborough
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a homicide after a man died following a stabbing on a TTC bus in Scarborough on Thursday evening.

articles.title: Hwy 401 WB ramp to Hwy 410 NB in Mississauga closed due transport truck in ditch
articles.summary: Ontario Provincial Police say the Highway 401 westbound ramp to Highway 410 northbound in Mississauga is closed due to a transport truck in a ditch. The driver suffered minor injuries. The ramp will be closed for an extended period of time for cleanup and removal of the truck. Drivers are advised to use alternate routes.

articles.title: The crisis at the corner of Queen & Bathurst
articles.summary: Queen and Bathurst feels like ground zero for the city's drug and homelessness crisis. Outreach workers and businesses say it's escalated since the corner's supervised consumption site closed. In this episode of This is Toronto, CBC's Haydn Watters shadows a team responding to overdoses and trying to ease the pain.

articles.title: How Hurontario LRT construction is hurting local businesses
articles.summary: Construction on the Hurontario LRT has been going on now for more than six years. With a completion date still unknown, CBC’s Nav Nanwa visited local businesses in the Cooksville neighbourhood of Mississauga to find out how they’re coping.

articles.title: 2nd suspect arrested in shooting death of woman downtown in June, police say
articles.summary: Toronto police say they have arrested a second suspect in the shooting death of a woman downtown in June.

articles.summary: A male motorcyclist has been taken to hospital with serious injuries after a crash involving a car in Moss Park on Thursday evening. articles.title: Anti-Black racism may have played a role in Jamal Francique's death, mother tells inquest
articles.summary: The mother of a man who was fatally shot by police during an attempted arrest in Mississauga, Ont., told a coroner's inquest today she believes anti-Black racism played a role in her son's death.

articles.title: 2 arrested after investigation into series of home invasions across GTA: Peel police
articles.summary: Two people have been charged as the result of an investigation into an alleged spree of home invasions, Peel Regional Police announced Thursday. Multiple charges related to the robberies, as well as illegal firearms, drugs and possession of child sexual abuse material have been laid, and police expect more arrests to come.
